title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) on password change
description: The password change form at /vulnerabilities/csrf/ uses GET method with no CSRF token. An attacker can change the admin password by tricking an authenticated user into visiting a crafted URL.
poc: The password change form at /vulnerabilities/csrf/ uses GET method with no CSRF token. An attacker can change the admin password by tricking an authenticated user into visiting: http://127.0.0.1:8080/vulnerabilities/csrf/?password_new=attackerpass&password_conf=attackerpass&Change=Change
